title: A support chat that slides in from the left
prompt: Build a help-centre page with a heading and a short paragraph in <main id="outlet">, and a chat panel titled "Support" that is open, slides in from the left edge, has the placeholder "Describe your problem" and starts with one assistant message: "How can I help?". The chat needs no store. No script.

assert.step: Wait for the panel to finish sliding in
The panel is titled Support and opens from the left
assert.eval: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('ui-chat-panel'); return c.heading === 'Support' && c.getAttribute('side') === 'left' && c.open; })()

assert.step: It is flush with the left edge
The composer has the requested placeholder
The page content is in the outlet
